paper.title: MAE ViT-L/16 ImageNet-1K pretraining (Section 4, Appendix A.1)

note: 800 epochs x 1,281,167 / 4,096 ≈ 250,200 steps; 40 warm-up epochs = 5%. Fine-tuning (Appendix A.2: 50 epochs ViT-L, layer-wise lr decay 0.75, RandAug, mixup/cutmix, drop path) is not implemented in this scaffold and must be added for the 85.9% ViT-L number. Requires an ImageNet loader.
